subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We want an agreement that works for both sides.
We have noted your offer and your point that copper, labour and especially electronic component costs have risen. Our proposal confirms a binding volume, and we are open to finding value together in the terms of the agreement.

We confirm a binding volume of 4580 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our demand forecast for this part is up 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).
Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 419.78 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, 4580 units a year.

What would you need from us to move further on the price? We are open to discussing any term that helps you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have reviewed your data; however, as our base prices are currently frozen, any price adjustments must be derived from the commercial terms. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. 

By accepting your proposed 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €432.15 per unit. Thus, our current Angebot comprises a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
